newsitem.title: USA: GM in ad deal with Sony theater - NYT.
newsitem.headline: GM in ad deal with Sony theater - NYT.

text.p: General Motors Corp is teaming up with Sony Corp to advertise its cars at a suburban Detroit movie theater -- not on the Big Screen, but in the parking lot outside and with displays throughout the theater, the New York Times said.
In Monday's edition, the Times said a 6,000-seat, 20-screen Sony theater in Southfield, Mich., is the test site for the new advertising technique.
Consumers who go to the theater will see cars on display outside and car-oriented advertisements inside, such as a display showing Evils with the Corvette he drove in the movie, "Clambake."
It's is incumbent upon us to find new and fresh ways to engage consumers, said Phil Guarascio, GM's general manager of marketing and advertising.
